detail.readme:
super-board

Add tasks, walk away, get merged PRs with proof.

Stop babysitting coding agents: cards you drop in Ready come back as tested, reviewed PRs.

9 skills (5 you type, 4 the board runs) · 9 commands · 6 guard hooks

🌐 Live site: erictechpro.github.io/super-board

⭐ Star this repo if it helps · Join the builders using this → weekly live calls, setup help · ▶ Watch the walkthrough

Install · Quick start · How it works · Skills · Commands · Guards

The skill map. Click it for the live version: zoom, pan, open any node.

## Install Before you start: - [ ] Claude Code, and `gh` with board access: `gh auth refresh -s project,read:project,repo` - [ ] Dynamic workflows on in `/config` ([backends](docs/super-board/README.md#backends)) - [ ] `verify_commands` set in your config, so the merge gate can prove the build ([setup notes](docs/super-board/README.md#setup-notes)) In your project folder: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EricTechPro/super-board/main/get.sh | bash ``` Or as a Claude Code plugin: ``` /plugin marketplace add EricTechPro/super-board /plugin install super-board@super-board ``` > [!NOTE] > The plugin ships the skills only. Run `/super-board:super-board onboard` and its 🔍 Checks step adds the guard hooks, scripts and workflows. Needs Claude Code, `gh`, `jq`, bash 3.2+ and Python 3.9+; the installer checks. ### Security Two security skills come with every install, and they stay separate: | Skill | Runs | Covers | |---|---|---| | [`pr-security-review`](skills/pr-security-review/README.md) | **On every PR**, inside the QA lane. Each finding fails QA and goes back to Build. | The PR's diff against its base: high-confidence, exploitable bugs only. From Anthropic's [claude-code-security-review](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review). | | `security-audit` | **Only when you ask** (`/security-audit`). The board never runs it. | The whole repository, in depth. From Cloudflare's [security-audit-skill](https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill), fetched at install with `npx skills`. | `--no-helper-skills` skips the `security-audit` download; `/super-board onboard` adds it later. Claude Code's built-in `/security-review` is left as it is. Running from Codex or OpenCode? See [supported hosts](docs/hosts.md) for tested versions, sign-in and gaps. Optional post-run learning can delegate an already installed `calibrate` skill after verified selected work completes. It applies only to explicitly permitted existing canonical skill files; the package bundles no private skill. See [post-run calibration](skills/super-board/references/calibration.md). ## Quick start ### 1. Install ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EricTechPro/super-board/main/get.sh | bash ``` ### 2. Onboard ``` /super-board onboard ``` Checks · GitHub · Board · Branch · AGENTS.md · Policies · Bug sources · Review. Enter takes the recommended answer. ### 3. Run ``` /super-board run my-app ``` Add cards to `Ready`. The board drains on its own. ## How it works **Which path?** Clear idea, foggy idea or bugs: [the routing rule](docs/super-board/routing.md) says what to run, and when 1–5 tickets go to `/implement-spec` instead of the board.

▶ Watch on YouTube: I Built a Self-Improving Software Factory

## Skills **9 skills (5 you type, 4 the board runs).** Uses [Matt Pocock skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), ponytail, impeccable, humanizer, [Anthropic's security review](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-security-review) and [Cloudflare's security-audit](https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill). **You type — 5 skills** | Skill | What it does | |---|---| | [`/super-board`](skills/super-board/README.md) | Orchestrator: plans waves, runs Build → QA → Review, merges when green. | | [`/super-collect`](skills/super-collect/README.md) | Finds problems, verifies them, writes a findings doc for /to-spec and /to-tickets. | | [`/ui-refine-loop`](skills/ui-refine-loop/README.md) | Critique → refine loop that polishes one page or component. | | [`/visual`](skills/visual/README.md) | One HTML page: branch recap, plan, or codebase map with diagrams. | | [`/git-sync`](skills/git-sync/README.md) | Commit per logical change, merge-pull, push without force, report. | **The board runs — 4 skills** | Skill | What it does | |---|---| | [`/super-build`](skills/super-build/README.md) | Builder lane: worktree, smallest safe change, tests, draft PR. | | [`/super-qa`](skills/super-qa/README.md) | Tester lane: evidence, test-gap check, screenshots, or bounce to Build. | | [`/super-review`](skills/super-review/README.md) | Reviewer lane: own hypotheses, remembers prior findings, merge gate. | | [`/pr-security-review`](skills/pr-security-review/README.md) | Security pass on every PR diff; super-qa runs it, findings fail QA. | Each name links to that skill's README. Adding a skill? Write its `SKILL.md` and `README.md`, add a line to `skills/families.json`, and this table updates itself. ## Commands ``` /super-board onboard # 8-step setup, resumes /super-board lint # vague ACs? /super-board status # read-only snapshot /super-board run # drain the board /super-board stop # stop workers /super-collect [source] # find problems → findings doc → /to-spec /ui-refine-loop # polish one page /visual [recap|plan|path] # one HTML page /git-sync # commit, pull, push ``` Flags: `run --low|--high` · `run --codex[=]` · `super-collect --since 30d` ## Guards & hooks Run automatically once installed. Python stdlib, JSON in, JSON out. | | | | --- | --- | | [guard-worktree-path](hooks/guard-worktree-path.py) | Blocks `git worktree add` outside `.claude/worktrees/` | | [guard-secrets](hooks/guard-secrets.py) | Blocks reading or piping dotenv files, SSH keys and credential files; key names via `super-board-env-check.sh` | | [guard-key-literals](hooks/guard-key-literals.py) | Blocks a live-looking API key written into a file; flags one already there | | [guard-delete-outside](hooks/guard-delete-outside.py) | Blocks `rm`, `find -delete` and `git clean` aimed outside the project, `~` or `/` | | [guard-protected-push](hooks/guard-protected-push.py) | Opt-in (`onboard` asks, or `install.sh --protect-main`): blocks direct and force pushes to main/master/base | | [README sync](scripts/super-board-readme-sync.py) | Regenerates the skill table; pre-commit and PostToolUse hooks keep it fresh | | [cleanup-wt](hooks/cleanup-wt.py) | Removes merged worktrees and branches after each merge and at session start, with a recovery file | | [merge gate](scripts/super-board-merge-gate.sh) | Merges only after the current base plus your non-empty project `verify_commands` pass (missing checks halt setup), pinned to the reviewed commit; applies `merge_policy` and runs allowed DB migrations | ## Models A cheap router grades each card easy, medium or hard first; the run flag picks the model for each grade. With `--codex`, every lane runs on Codex GPT models instead of Claude. | Command | Router | Easy card | Medium card | Hard card | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `/super-board run` | Haiku 4.5 | Sonnet 5.5 | Opus 5.5 | session model | | `/super-board run --low` | Haiku 4.5 | Haiku 4.5 | Sonnet 5.5 | Opus 5.5 | | `/super-board run --high` | Sonnet 5.5 | Opus 5.5 | Opus 5.5 | Opus 5.5 | | `/super-board run --codex` | gpt-6-luna | gpt-6.1-sol | gpt-6.1-sol | gpt-6-astra | | `/super-board run --codex --low` | gpt-6-luna | gpt-6-luna | gpt-6.1-sol | gpt-6.1-sol | | `/super-board run --codex --high` | gpt-6-luna | gpt-6-astra | gpt-6-astra | gpt-6-astra | `/super-board run --codex=` pins one model for every card and skips the router. Run inside Codex? plain `/super-board run` switches to the Codex ladder by itself. Codex has no `/super-board` command: it finds skills in `.agents/skills/` (symlinks followed), so link `.claude/skills/super-board` there and type `$super-board run`. ## Writing standard Commits, tickets, PR bodies and comments all follow [one writing standard](https://erictechpro.github.io/super-board/writing-standard/), in the pack and in every project it is installed into.
Upgrading from 2.x 1. Re-run the install line. 2. Run `/super-board onboard`; step 1 upgrades for you and keeps a backup. 3. Try `board-migrate --dry-run` on a copy of your board first. [Full notes](RELEASE-NOTES.md#upgrading-from-2x)

### Worker skill availability Setup and dispatch resolve real, nonempty `SKILL.md` files for the actual Claude or Codex host. Missing required skills halt before claims or workers; lockfiles and arbitrary plugin caches do not count. The shared registry in `scripts/super-board-skills-ready.py` owns lane dependencies, overrides and the two declared ponytail fallbacks. The QA lane requires the bundled `pr-security-review`; Cloudflare's `security-audit` is an optional QA entry, so a missing copy never halts a run. Setup's full helper union may be red while a selected card is runnable. Read-only checks never install; explicit onboard repair rechecks files after installation. The CLI accepts `--home ` and `--catalog `. Launchers accept the same inventory through `SUPER_BOARD_SKILLS_HOME` and `SUPER_BOARD_SKILLS_CATALOG`; neither changes the actual host. Catalog shape: `{"host":"codex","skills":[{"name":"vendor:skill","path":"/exact/SKILL.md", "enabled":true,"scope":"project","project_root":"/exact/project"}]}`. User entries use `scope:"user"`. Restart explicitly after repairing missing skills; readiness certifies availability, not their content or external tools.
